# LeagueBuilds Release Notes

## Code signing policy

Free code signing provided by SignPath.io, certificate by SignPath Foundation.

Privacy policy: [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/CookieDecide/LeagueBuilds/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)

Project roles:
- Committers and reviewers: CookieDecide
- Approvers: CookieDecide

Signing rules:
- Only release artifacts built from this repository are signed.
- Only binaries produced by the LeagueBuilds build pipeline are included in signed packages.
- Version numbers must match across all signed binaries in a release.
- Third-party libraries may be included as unsigned upstream components when required by the package format.

## Instructions

- Download LeaguBuilds.exe from the Assets section of this release page.
- Run the executable on Windows after League of Legends and the Riot Client are installed.
- Open the client, let it detect the selected champion, and use the import flow to apply the recommended setup.
- If the client shows a version mismatch, download the newest release from this page.
